data.name: Tales of Wind Online
data.detailed_description:
Tales of Wind Online is a 3D fantasy MMORPG where action-driven, non-targeting combat meets immersive exploration and rich social systems. Built for PC with upgraded visuals, smooth controls, and large-scale multiplayer features, it offers both new adventurers and returning veterans a fresh experience filled with strategy, adventure, and companionship.

A fantasy adventure, the Divine Child returns!
Do you still remember the wise-eyed little dog in Sacred Tree Town?
The ambush by Ahri when first arriving in Laplace City?
Now, the seven great calamities of the past have awakened once more, and a new adventure is about to begin.
Will you once again become the hero who saves the world?

【Brand New Powerful Class – Dragon Blade】

Blazing sword energy tears through enemies, while close-range assaults strike without warning.
With exclusive damage boosts and insight, this class dominates the battlefield.

  • Shadow Slash Branch: Ultra-fast blade draws to dash through foes, then retreat instantly.

  • Phantom Sword Branch: Harness time and space to control elements and turn the tide of battle.

【Soul Card Transformation System】

Collect and embed soul cards into equipment to gain diverse abilities. Transform during boss fights to unleash powerful new forms.

  • Weapon Soul Card: Unlocks transformation into unique creatures with special powers.

  • Glove Soul Card: Provides active combat skills for attack, defense, or healing.

  • Armor Soul Card: Adds attribute boosts and defensive effects.

【Mysterious Guardians Join】

Mysterious beings from beyond the dimensional gate will become your exclusive guardians. They fight alongside you across Yarsdore, supporting your journey against unknown threats.

【Non-Targeting Combat System】

Enjoy free movement, fluid dodging, and thrilling combos from a top-down perspective. Break free from traditional combat constraints for exhilarating action.

【Random Dungeon Mechanism】

Never get bored with repetitive dungeons! Each entry generates random buffs and mechanics, such as continuous healing, burst damage, or negative-status immunity. Every battle is a fresh challenge.

【Shadowed Time Instance】

A new dungeon system with randomly generated maps, monsters, and effects ensures each run is unique. Adapt your strategies to ever-changing battle conditions.

【Fully Upgraded Convenience Features】

  • Free teleport for beginners for faster progression.

  • Quick gear swap to adapt instantly to combat.

  • Batch crafting and synthesis for efficiency.

  • Instant channel switching to avoid congestion.

  • Auto-pickup and dismantle systems so you can focus on the fight.

【Various Optimizations and Adjustments】

  • Main quest and tutorial system refinements for smoother progression.

  • New instance lobby for quick matchmaking.

  • Continuous system updates and quality-of-life improvements.

Get ready to embark on a visually stunning, action-packed fantasy adventure with endless surprises in Tales of Wind Online!

data.short_description: Tales of Wind Online is a 3D fantasy MMORPG featuring non-target combat and a top-down view. Enjoy fast, fluid battles with full movement control. Team up to defeat massive bosses with real-time tactics. Experience stunning 4K visuals, smooth PC gameplay, a new class, and exciting IP crossover!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win10/Win11
  • Processor: Intel Pentium4 2.8 GHz and above, AMD K8 2600+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GeForce 8400 and above, ATI Radeon X1600 and above
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win10/Win11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo 2.66 GHz and above, AMD Athlon 64 X2 6000+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GeForce 9500 and above, ATI Radeon HD4570 and above
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
